Container.Name: projectionist
Container.Overview: Cinema intelligence for your personal archive. Chat-first companion for your Plex library with BYOP LLM, RAG over your collection, TMDB discovery, and confirmation-gated Radarr/Sonarr add/remove. Keep port 8788 on a trusted LAN — do not WAN-expose without an authenticated reverse proxy. Config: /mnt/user/appdata/projectionist/config (legacy …/curatorx/config OK if never migrated). Updates: if Force Update shows 0 B pulled, SSH `docker pull romwil/projectionist:latest` or appdata `./rollout.sh` (see Unraid wiki).
Container.Requires: Plex Media Server on your LAN. Optional: Radarr, Sonarr, Tautulli, Fanart.tv, and an LLM API key or Ollama on the Unraid host.

Container.Description:
Projectionist is cinema intelligence for your personal archive — chat with a companion that knows your Plex library. Connect Plex, Radarr, Sonarr, TMDB, and your preferred LLM provider (cloud API or Ollama).
**Updating (important)** - Repository default: `romwil/projectionist:latest` (pin `:1.30` / `:1.30.2` if preferred). During the compatibility window the same digests are also published as `romwil/curatorx:*`. - If **Force Update** reports **TOTAL DATA PULLED: 0 B** and the app stays on an old version, Docker kept a stale local tag. SSH: `docker pull romwil/projectionist:latest` then Force Update / Apply, or `cd /mnt/user/appdata/projectionist && ./rollout.sh latest`. Do not wipe `/config`. - Full notes: https://github.com/romwil/projectionist/blob/main/docs/wiki/Unraid.md
**Config path** - Preferred: `/mnt/user/appdata/projectionist/config` (default below). - Legacy installs that never migrated may keep `/mnt/user/appdata/curatorx/config`.
**Security** - Bind to a trusted LAN or put Projectionist behind an authenticated reverse proxy. - Do **not** port-forward bare `:8788` to the internet. - Optional multi-user: set `PROJECTIONIST_SESSION_SECRET` (or accept the auto-generated secret under Config). Legacy `CURATORX_SESSION_SECRET` still works during the compatibility window. - Plex webhooks require `PROJECTIONIST_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (legacy `CURATORX_WEBHOOK_SECRET` / `X-CuratorX-Webhook-Secret` still accepted). - Optional MCP at `/mcp`: set privacy and/or full API keys (they must differ), or generate them in **Admin → Advanced**.
**First run** 1. Open the Web UI at port **8788**. 2. Complete setup in **Settings** / **Admin** (Plex server URL + token, TMDB, LLM; optionally Radarr/Sonarr). 3. Map movie and TV libraries, then run **Sync library**. 4. Start chatting with the curator.
**Optional:** Tautulli for watch stats and purge suggestions; Fanart.tv for richer poster art. For Ollama on the Unraid host, set `LLM_PROVIDER=ollama` and `LLM_BASE_URL=http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1` (Extra Parameters already add `host.docker.internal`).
**Live Channels (Tunarr):** BYO Tunarr URL works with no socket. For managed Tunarr (Projectionist pull/start/stop), enable the optional **Docker Socket** path under Show more settings / advanced — host `/var/run/docker.sock` → container `/var/run/docker.sock`. That mount is root-equivalent; leave it blank unless you want turnkey orchestration. ExtraParams includes --group-add 281 so the non-root app user can use Unraid's docker.sock (GID 281). When the socket is mounted, also set **Host data dir (Tunarr)** to the same host path as Config (default `/mnt/user/appdata/projectionist/config`) so Tunarr's volume is not created at a bogus host `/config/tunarr`.
**Support:** [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/romwil/projectionist/issues) · [Unraid wiki](https://github.com/romwil/projectionist/blob/main/docs/wiki/Unraid.md)

Config.Description: Optional seed: LLM base URL (e.g. http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1 for Ollama)

Config.Name: LLM_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional seed: LLM API key (not required for Ollama)

Config.Name: LLM_MODEL
Config.Description: Optional seed: chat model name

Config.Name: PROJECTIONIST_SESSION_SECRET
Config.Description: Optional: strong secret for multi-user session cookies (auto-generated under Config if unset)

Config.Name: Owner username
Config.Description: Multi-user first-owner setup: username for the seeded owner account (defaults to 'owner').

Config.Name: Owner password
Config.Description: Multi-user first-owner setup: set a password to seed the owner account so the first login cannot be raced on a shared LAN. Sign in with this username + password. Rotating it here and restarting resets the owner password (no lockout). Leave blank to keep legacy first-login-claims-owner behavior. Min 8 characters.

Config.Name: PROJECTIONIST_WEBHOOK_SECRET
Config.Description: Secret for Plex webhook auth header X-Projectionist-Webhook-Secret (required if using webhooks)

Config.Name: PROJECTIONIST_MCP_API_KEY
Config.Description: Privacy MCP key for HTTP /mcp — public schema, read-only. Leave empty to generate in Admin → Advanced.

Config.Name: PROJECTIONIST_MCP_FULL_API_KEY
Config.Description: Full MCP key for trusted in-stack /mcp (internal fields + confirm-gated *arr). Must differ from the privacy key. Or generate in Admin → Advanced.

Config.Name: PROJECTIONIST_MCP_FULL_CONFIRM
Config.Description: Active-curation scope: set to 1 to let the full MCP key confirm/execute its own *arr proposals. Off by default — a human confirms on the web plane. Only grant to trusted in-stack automation.

Config.Name: PROJECTIONIST_SECRETS_KEY
Config.Description: Optional dedicated key for encrypting UI-saved secrets in settings.json. Back this up with /config. When unset, encryption material is derived from the session secret.
